subject.title: [Feature]: Allow pinning plugin tabs in the Control UI sidebar

question: Should the shared Control UI sidebar persist generic plugin-tab pins, including valid pins whose descriptors are temporarily unavailable, as part of the supported customization contract?
rationale: This is a new persisted core-UI capability spanning plugin descriptors and user navigation preferences; the implementation can be bounded, but maintainers must choose the intended long-term contract before contributors encode it.

options.title: Sponsor generic plugin-tab pins
options.body: Adopt a stable generic plugin-tab entry in the sidebar preference model, with unavailable entries retained but omitted from rendering.

options.title: Keep plugin tabs under More
options.body: Retain the current separation and document that plugin tabs are intentionally not pinnable.

recommendation.title: Sponsor generic plugin-tab pins
recommendation.body: Adopt a stable generic plugin-tab entry in the sidebar preference model, with unavailable entries retained but omitted from rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter has already validated a prototype and can refine it into a focused PR once the persistent-sidebar contract is confirmed.
